issues.problem: ちゃいました is equally correct with the same English for every mishap stem (all take ちゃ, none じゃ) but was not listed.
issues.action: Added ちゃいました as an alternative in the focus slot (てしまいました/ちゃいました).

issues.problem: The full form てしまう is equally correct with the same English but was not listed as an alternative.
issues.action: Added てしまう as an alternative in the focus slot (ちゃう/てしまう).

issues.problem: Distractor てあげてください forms natural sentences close to the English (子供がすぐ帰ってくるので、玄関の鍵を開けてあげてください); variable 'reason' also had only 5 values (minimum 6).
issues.action: Replaced the distractor with てもらってください (have someone else do it, plainly wrong for 'please leave ...'); added reason value 夕方に父が帰ってくる / my father is coming home this evening (252 combinations).
